description: Issue summary: Starting 2026-03-11 02:10 UTC we observed a sustained increase in 5xx responses for a set of enterprise customers (notably SparkDocs Inc) routed through the us-east-1 API gateway. Impact: ~12% request error rate increase for embedding and short streaming requests for ~3 hours; several tenant requests hit P1 SLA thresholds. Environment: prod (us-east-1). Symptoms: API gateway returned 502/503/504; upstream runtime logs show frequent worker restarts and OOMs; accept queue length spiked for affected frontends. Hypothesis initially: kernel fallback / nvml glitch; later investigation pointed to priority-shim eviction + UVM worker thrash amplified by hedged retries and a large embedding bulk retry loop from one tenant.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Send a mix of short text-gen and frequent small-batch embedding requests from a single tenant with high connection concurrency and hedged-retry enabled.
2) Simulate background large embedding bulk (30k vectors) prefetch on same tenant to cause long-running KV cache prefetch tasks.
3) Observe accept-queue growth on ingress and priority-shim evictions moving short requests to lower priority buckets.
4) Note runtime UVM worker CPU/memory thrash as prefetched jobs compete with real-time streams, causing OOM kills and hedged retry amplification.
5) Result: API gateway 5xx elevation and client-observed failures.
logs: [2026-03-11T02:12:36Z] runtime-worker-3 PID=4512 OOMKill invoked, nvml_free_mem=0.4GB, kv_cache_evictions=127
[2026-03-11T02:14:10Z] ingress-prioritizer: demoted 18 sessions due to shim-eviction; hedged_retry_counter tenant=SparkDocs Inc = 23
comments: Maya Chen (Reporter) [2026-03-11 03:05 UTC]: Customer reported sharp increase in 5xxs; provided example request IDs and timeline. Customer impact: dashboarding functions failed for 10% of queries.
Liam O'Connor (Assignee) [2026-03-11 03:20 UTC]: Triage started; pulled apigw and runtime metrics. Noted accept_queue spike correlated with long-running prefetch tasks from a single tenant.
SRE (Anika Rao) [2026-03-11 04:00 UTC]: Reproduced queue growth in staging with scaled embedding prefetch. Observed priority_shim counter incrementing and evictions causing head-of-line blocking.

Eng (Diego Morales) [2026-03-11 06:45 UTC]: Confirmed runtime OOMs caused by UVM worker threads pinned to large prefetches; hedged retries amplified ingress pressure. Opening PR to add eviction throttles and backpressure for prefetch jobs.

Liam O'Connor [2026-03-12 09:10 UTC]: Applied hotfix: reduce prefetch concurrency for tenant-scoped background jobs and add temporary priority_shim cap on apigw. Error rates dropped to baseline within 20 minutes.
SparkDocs Support Rep (J. Alvarez) [2026-03-12 11:02 UTC]: Confirmed customer saw degraded queries for ~2.5 hours. Customer accepted workaround and requested postmortem.
investigation_notes: Correlation: apigw accept_queue growth precedes runtime OOMs by ~30-90s; hedged retries count spiked after accept queue hits threshold.

The long embedding prefetch was consuming UVM pinned memory and multiple worker threads without yielding; this caused GPU memory fragmentation and failed allocations for short-lived inference requests.

Ingress prioritizer's shim eviction logic was too aggressive: it dropped new short requests into low-priority pools instead of returning fast failures, which multiplied connections and kept sockets open.

Metrics consulted: apigw/accept_queue, ingress-prioritizer/shim_evictions, runtime/oom_kills, runtime/uvm_mem_free, hedged_retry/attempts. Dashboards: /d/ingress/accept-health; runbook: confluence/Runbooks/ingress-prioritizer.
Repro in staging: reproduced with a tenant-level background job generating KV-prefetch load + aggressive client hedged retry settings.
root_cause: Combination of an unbounded tenant-scoped embedding prefetch workload monopolizing UVM worker resources and an ingress prioritizer shim eviction policy that demoted short requests into lower-priority buckets rather than failing fast. This created head-of-line blocking, hedged-retry amplification at the API gateway, and downstream runtime OOMs leading to elevated 5xx rates.
mitigation: Immediate: Apply temporary cap to priority_shim_evictions (apigw feature flag) and throttle tenant prefetch concurrency for identified tenant (SparkDocs Inc).
Short-term: Deploy hotfix to ingress prioritizer that returns 429 for demoted requests under extreme accept_queue pressure instead of demotion, reducing stuck sockets.
Short-term: Add runtime guard to detect UVM worker pinned memory > 80% and pause new prefetch tasks until memory reclaimed.
Customer-facing: Notified SparkDocs support and provided recommended client hedged-retry configuration (increase backoff, reduce concurrent hedged attempts).
resolution: Hotfix rolled: ingress-prioritizer change to fast-fail demoted requests (returned 429 instead of demotion) deployed 2026-03-11 08:15 UTC; observed apigw 5xx rate return to baseline within 20 minutes.
Applied tenant prefetch concurrency limit for SparkDocs Inc (temporary) 2026-03-11 08:25 UTC.
Runtime patch to add UVM worker memory guard merged: PR gh/4201, rolled to canary 2026-03-12, full rollout 2026-03-13.

Post-incident: scheduled follow-up to revisit prioritizer eviction strategy and add synthetic checks for hedged-retry amplification during tenant bulk jobs. Confluence postmortem link: confluence/RWD/postmortems/SUP-286543 (pending).
